title: Microsoft prepares Project Perception for public preview with a specialised cyber model
friendlyTitle: Microsoft is launching AI agents for security work
summary: Microsoft has outlined Project Perception, an agentic security system that coordinates specialised models and security agents to find and help remediate software vulnerabilities. Its MAI-Cyber-1-Flash model is intended to handle more routine security work, with public preview scheduled for August 3.
friendlySummary: Project Perception uses several AI agents to find software weaknesses and help fix them. A public preview is planned for August 3.
whyItMatters: Security teams may be able to reserve expensive frontier models and human attention for difficult cases while automating broader scanning. Organisations should treat the preview as an assisted defence tool, with permissions, audit trails and human review around remediation.
friendlyWhyItMatters: This could help security teams check more software without using the most expensive AI for every task. People should still review important fixes.
